_annotation.name: Loyalty Tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
_annotation.what: Tier definitions for the loyalty program — points thresholds, labels, and benefits per tier. Used by loyalty/index.json to render the program details.
_annotation.why: Tiered loyalty programs create aspirational behavior. When customers know they're 20 points away from Gold status, they return to hit that threshold. Clear tier benefits make the reward tangible.
_annotation.ai_popolates: Points thresholds: AI calculates from your average transaction value. Benefits: Generated to match your margin structure. Higher tiers get exponentially better rewards to incentivize progression.
_annotation.your_input: Tell us your average service price and whether you want 3 or 5 tiers. We configure the points-per-Guaraní ratio and redemption thresholds.
_annotation.plan: Crecimiento+ — Profesional includes custom tier names and rewards
